items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Jimmy Cleveland was with us out there.

ctx.x: Yeah, nine and a half years. Almost ten years. Jimmy Cleveland was with us out there. Kai Winding. A very, very heavyweight band. One of the best on television, ever. But playing nonsense.
But you put four or five hours a day into that show?
